chapter: Other bands, mutes, arrangers and composers
title: Favorite popular composers and what New Orleans audiences requested
summary: DeDroit says audiences wanted nationally known hits like Stardust and Night and Day rather than local New Orleans composers.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

I guess I was just like everybody else. I like the, you know, Body and Soul and things like that, you know.
